name: @ptt/desktop
description: Help players and modders from many Paradox games to manage language and localisation files within mods
author: Khoeos

scripts.build:win: pnpm run build && pnpm run _deploy:prod && pnpm --dir=./dist-deploy exec electron-builder --win
scripts.build:linux: pnpm run build && pnpm run _deploy:prod && pnpm --dir=./dist-deploy exec electron-builder --linux
scripts.build:mac: pnpm run build && pnpm run _deploy:prod && pnpm --dir=./dist-deploy exec electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:unpack: pnpm run build && pnpm run _deploy:prod && pnpm --dir=./dist-deploy exec electron-builder --dir
scripts.release: pnpm run build && pnpm run _deploy:prod && pnpm --dir=./dist-deploy exec electron-builder --publish always
scripts.dist: pnpm run build && pnpm run _deploy:prod && pnpm --dir=./dist-deploy exec electron-builder --publish never
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.clean: rimraf dist dist-deploy out test-results playwright-report .turbo
